caption: The video captures a nighttime grove lined with rows of slender trees, where an intense overexposed white-yellow light glows from the central background, washing the grass in bright green against a dark sky. A single silhouetted person is positioned in the middle ground with back to the camera, facing the luminous clearing. Throughout the excerpt the figure moves slowly away, receding toward the bright area as the legs alternate between apart and together poses in a steady walking gait. The camera drifts steadily, sliding the dark foreground trunks and the tree rows toward the left edge of the frame while the person grows slightly smaller and higher in the view. Tree canopies and leaves shift subtly, and the blown-out light patch changes its outline yet remains dominant. The person remains the only clearly moving figure, and the walk toward the glowing clearing continues without resolution.
